summary: ICON PLC filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly financial report for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings release and does not disclose any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. As a non-US issuer, the Form 6-K serves the same function as a US Form 10-Q. The filing presents standard financial statements and notes, with no event requiring classification under special-situations categories.
